sh: Nvidia reports as tech stocks slide
headline: Nvidia reports its results after its CEO’s exit, as tech stocks slide
summary: Nvidia, the main maker of AI chips, reports quarterly results after the US market closes on Tuesday 17 November. Its chief executive Jensen Huang resigned last week, and US tech stocks fell sharply on Monday.
why: Nvidia makes most of the chips used to build artificial intelligence, so its results and its leadership affect the whole AI industry and a large part of the stock market. Many pension and savings funds hold its shares.

event.t: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia’s chief executive on Thursday 12 November, the company’s board said. It followed reports of affairs, including one with a woman US intelligence agencies suspect of spying for China.
Chief financial officer Colette Kress is interim chief executive while the company looks for a permanent replacement.
On Monday 16 November the S&P 500 fell 1.9% and the Nasdaq 2.5%. Nvidia shares fell 4.1% to $156.14, their lowest close since July 2025, CNN reports.
Nvidia publishes its quarterly results after the market closes on Tuesday. Investors see them as a test of the AI boom.

effects.label: Tech stocks
effects.t: Investors cut risk before the results, and chip and AI shares led Monday’s fall.

effects.label: AI industry
effects.t: Nvidia’s sales forecast will show whether demand for AI chips is still growing.
